Sana: Quick sync — GlacialCloud reached out asking to onboard their iceland-1 region to the marketplace. They want go-live target 2025-06-10. Need capacity quota, entitlement, KMS key flow, and legal checklist. @Devon @Mateo can you triage?
Devon: Thanks. Do we have expected GPU types/sku counts from them? Need that to size quotas and confirm Dedicated vs Hosted routing.
Marco (GlacialCloud): Hey all — typical nodes are 8xA100-80GB per rack, initial request 16 GPUs (2 racks) with ability to scale to 64 within 30 days. Can provide certs for hardware and DC SOC2 report.
Mateo: 16 GPUs initial — noted. We usually map A100-80 to sku:gpu.a100_80.room. Will need partner entitlement + marketplace SKU created. I'll open a ticket with marketplace-bot.
marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-8942 for marketplace SKU & entitlement provisioning — https://go/internal/MP-8942
Devon: On quotas: ops needs region quota request to cloud partner (GlacierCloud? ;)) — @Marco can you confirm the preferred cloud provider for island deployment? (Is this partner-managed infra or an edge partner plug to our existing cloud accounts?)
Marco (GlacialCloud): It's partner-managed VPCs in Reykjavik; we'll provide peering. Prefer us to provision marketplace entitlement and they will accept billing via marketplace.
Sana: Important: because partner-managed, legal & security insist on KMS integration and key ownership clarity. Ingrid, any blockers on DPA / key custody?
Ingrid: For partner-managed infra we need customer-keyed KMS where Redwood does not hold plaintext keys. We'll require a DSAR and updated DPA addendum for external partner-hosted regions. Also need export controls check; Iceland has some nuances. I'll draft addendum.
Mateo: KMS flow technical: can we support partner-supplied external key via HSM? If not, we can do envelope keys where partner holds CMK. Need ops input.
Devon: Ops note: our current marketplace onboarding supports two options: 1) Redwood KMS + provider key policy with key shared at grant level OR 2) partner-managed KMS with attestations + key policy file. Option 2 needs extra review but is feasible. We'll need HSM cert and key policy from Marco.
Marco (GlacialCloud): We can supply an HSM attestation and key policy JSON. Example snippet attached:```json
{
  "key_id": "glacial-iceland-1-kms",
  "hsm_provider": "Thales",
  "attestation": "base64-enc-cert"
}
```
Sana: Great. Action items: Mateo create marketplace SKU ticket (MP-8942 created), Devon open quota request to partner console, Ingrid draft DPA addendum. Marco to upload HSM attestation and SOC2 link to the ticket. Target checkpoints: engineering review 2025-05-20, legal signoff 2025-05-30, soft-launch 2025-06-10.
k8s-deploy-bot: Created infra task INF-4721 for peering, VPC and route setup.
Devon: I'll coordinate dev-ops runbook for fallback routing (if partner capacity dips we fallback to eu-west-1 hosted variant). Need model pinning conversation with Runtime team; cc @Mateo for perf testing.
Mateo: I'll schedule a perf run: baseline latency + token cost for iceland vs eu-west-1. Will share results in MP-8942 by 2025-05-15.
Sana: One more ask — marketing wants joint announcement copy. Who owns partner quote? Marco?
Marco (GlacialCloud): Yes, we can provide a short partner quote and logo (SVG). We'll upload to MP-8942.
Sana: Perfect. I'll follow up with a quick checklist: 1) MP-8942 marketplace SKU & entitlements (Mateo) 2) INF-4721 infra peering & quota (Devon) 3) Legal addendum (Ingrid) 4) HSM & SOC2 artifacts (Marco) 5) Perf verification & rollout plan (Mateo/Devon).
Ingrid: Logging for compliance — ensure audit logs are forwarded to our audit-s3 for 7 years. Marco, confirm retention on your side.
Marco (GlacialCloud): Confirmed retention and log-forwarding support.
Sana: OK — everyone, please post updates in MP-8942 and ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
